from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    # Extend each side of the rectangular 2 block along unobstructed rows/columns.
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        if not any(grid[r][c] not in (0, 2) for c in range(c0)):
            for c in range(c0): out[r][c] = 2
        if not any(grid[r][c] not in (0, 2) for c in range(c1 + 1, w)):
            for c in range(c1 + 1, w): out[r][c] = 2
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        if not any(grid[r][c] not in (0, 2) for r in range(r0)):
            for r in range(r0): out[r][c] = 2
        if not any(grid[r][c] not in (0, 2) for r in range(r1 + 1, h)):
            for r in range(r1 + 1, h): out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
